property_summary: For any actor and any positive deposit, calling withdrawAll must drain the full deposited amount from the contract (address(c).balance becomes 0); the mutant's guard `oCredit > 1` blocks withdrawal when the credit is exactly 1 wei, leaving 1 wei stuck.
change_summary: Change the guard `if (oCredit > 0)` to `if (oCredit > 1)` so a caller with exactly one wei of credit can no longer withdraw.
